message.content: We need a live mid-conversation provider handoff in Eve: a session running on Anthropic should be able to switch to OpenAI without losing the transcript, the in-flight tool state, or the running cost total. Please implement it on top of pi-ai's context serialization. Why this matters: Anthropic rate-limits us at peak and we want to fail over.

content.text: Plan for the handoff: pi-ai serializes a provider-neutral context (messages + pending tool calls) so I can snapshot the Anthropic client, create an OpenAI client, and rehydrate. The running cost total lives in the usage meter, which resets per client — so I'll carry it across by reading usage.total before the swap and seeding it after. Reading the pi-ai serialization surface and our session wrapper first.

That's the whole mechanism: serializeContext() gives me messages + pendingToolCalls + meta, and hydrateContext() replays them into a fresh client of any provider — including a tool round-trip that was mid-flight. So the handoff is snapshot → new client → hydrate. The cost total is the only thing serializeContext doesn't carry, so I handle usage separately. Reading our session wrapper.

AiSession already mirrors costUsd from the usage meter after each send, so I have a stable running total to carry. Writing the handoff method: serialize the current client, create the target-provider client, hydrate it, swap it in, and re-seed the cost baseline so usage.total keeps accumulating from where Anthropic left off rather than resetting to zero.

content.content: applied: added handoff(provider, model) to AiSession; costBaseline seeds the carried total

content.text: Now the running-total accounting. usage.total on the new client starts at zero, so the session's reported cost must be costBaseline + client.usage.total.costUsd. The decision I'm settling on: keep costBaseline on the session and compute the displayed total as baseline + current-client total, so a handoff never double-counts and never drops the pre-swap spend. Updating the cost mirror to use the baseline.

input.content:
// cost mirror now: baseline (carried across handoffs) + current client's total
  get costUsd() { return (this.costBaseline ?? 0) + this.client.usage.total.costUsd }

content.content: applied: costUsd is now a getter combining costBaseline + current client total

content.text: Writing tests for the handoff: transcript preserved, a pending tool call resumes on the new provider, and the running cost total carries across without reset or double-count.

content.content:
bun test v1.3
✓ handoff preserves transcript and resumes a pending tool call
✓ running cost total carries across a handoff
✓ new provider keeps the same stream event shape
 3 pass  0 fail  (389ms)

content.text: Done. Summary: AiSession.handoff(provider, model) snapshots the current client with serializeContext, spins up the target-provider client, and hydrateContext replays the transcript plus any in-flight pendingToolCalls — so a tool round-trip survives an Anthropic→OpenAI swap. The running cost total is carried via costBaseline, and costUsd is now baseline + current-client usage so the total never resets or double-counts. Tests confirm transcript preservation, tool resumption, and cost continuity. Handoff to the failover work: trigger handoff('openai', ...) on an Anthropic 429, and surface the active provider in the copilot panel header so users see the switch.
